## Kind

- [ ] Content (encounters, jokes, radio, places)

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 tools/validate_content.py` passes
- [ ] I ran the game and saw the change work (say on what machine, and fps if it touches rendering)
- [ ] Content follows the [rules](../CONTRIBUTING.md#ground-rules-for-content): everyone equally, no slurs, invented people, nothing from commercial games or brands
- [ ] Every new third-party file has a row in `assets/CREDITS.md` with its source and licence
